label: Pregnant belly touched / kissed / talked to by kids
group_title: Kids and the pregnant belly (family moment)
description: Innocent, non-sexual family scenes where children touch, kiss, listen to or talk to a visibly pregnant woman's belly. Human characters only (Peppa Pig removed in 8ddbbc2).

records.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air — "Hilary Gets a Job"
records.meta: US · English · sitcom, S3E4 (NBC, aired 5 Oct 1992)
records.summary: Will plays music to his pregnant Aunt Viv's belly because he heard babies respond to music, and she feels the baby kick; it's a light family moment.
records.kids_note: Nephew Will Smith (teen, lives with the family) does the belly scene; Viv's children Hilary, Carlton and Ashley
records.pregnancy_outcome: Son Nicky born later in season 3
records.evidence: single source for the belly scene (episode transcript); episode details from Wikipedia, Rotten Tomatoes and Clip.Cafe

records.title: Bella in the Belly / Bella w brzuszku
records.meta: Poland · Polish · 2D animated preschool series, 26 × 6 min (Animoon)
records.summary: Five-year-old Benny puts his ear to and touches his mother's pregnant belly to talk to his unborn sister Bella, explaining the world to her through imagination.
records.pregnancy_outcome: not stated (the series premise keeps Bella unborn)
records.evidence: Animoon; CEE Animation; Zlín Film Festival; Ale Kino! festival
